title: ilex crenata f. latifolia
intro: Ilex crenata f. latifolia, commonly known as Japanese holly fern or glossy holly fern, is a variety of the Ilex crenata species, a type of evergreen shrub native to East Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Ilex crenata f. latifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
